structured.answer: Keep the keren hishtalmut: my employer puts in up to 7.5% and I put in 2.5%, and after 6 years from the first payment I can take it all out tax-free. Taking it out earlier is possible but heavily taxed (up to 47%), so I leave it alone for 6 years.

stuck.why: 'קרן ההשתלמות משאירה 415.84 ₪ יותר' looked tiny, and costs 2,402 vs 466 made the keren look worse; only later saw the employer money is 'מחוץ להשוואה'
Asks for gross 'משכורת ברוטו', I only know my net 9,500, so I left 12,000
Didn't understand why only part of my deposit counts

used: Heading and 'מה זה' paragraph: 7.5% employer, 2.5% me, 6 years tax-free
'למה משתמשים בזה' first line: 'כמעט תמיד הצעד הראשון'
Fees table 'עד 2% בשנה' with company names
Orange warning 'משיכה לפני הזמן אפשרית, אבל יקרה' 47%
not_found: Calculation with my own net salary
Clear shekel figure for how much the employer money adds

findings.what: The headline difference 415.84 ₪ excludes the employer's money, making the keren look barely worth it, and costs look higher than the alternative
Calculator asks for gross salary; a salaried person often only knows net
300 ₪ / 200 ₪ split explanation is confusing without explaining the term
Codes like TXH-09, PF-18 mean nothing to a normal reader
Fees shown only as percent 'עד 2%', no shekel amount
